answers.workaround:
No. My current solution is to use Git Submodules. This usually involves [forking the addon to delete extra project files](https://github.com/SdgGames/gdUnit4), then [including my fork as a submodule in the addons folder](https://gitlab.com/20-games-in-30-days/godot-4-game-template/-/tree/main/addons?ref_type=heads).

This solution is tedious and requires me to manually keep my fork up to date with the addon's master project
